summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for La Maison d'Auben V1. 22/22 pytest backend tests passed (public content, newsletter, contact, Stripe checkout, admin JWT). Full end-to-end Stripe test purchase completed successfully: buy-now-btn -> Stripe hosted checkout -> pay with 4242 test card -> redirect to /paiement/succes -> download-product-btn returns valid xlsx (Budget-mensuel-La-Maison-dAuben.xlsx). All public pages (/, /boutique, /boutique/budget-mensuel, /ressources, /ressources/:slug, /a-propos, /contact, /faq, /cgv, /mentions-legales, /confidentialite) return 200. Admin flow verified: /admin without token -> /admin/login; login with admin@lamaisondauben.fr/Auben2026! -> /admin dashboard with Produits/Commandes/Newsletter/Messages tabs; Commandes tab lists Budget order; logout returns to /admin/login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~660 lines — approaching size threshold; consider splitting admin, payments, and public routers into separate modules for long-term maintainability.

seed() runs on every startup and overwrites products (except gallery) using $set — admin edits to product fields (short_description, features, contents, faq, compatibility, price) will be reverted on backend restart. Consider using $setOnInsert for full doc and only setting select fields on updates, or gating seed with an env flag.

ensure_stripe_catalog() is called synchronously in @app.on_event('startup') without await/thread offload; it does network calls to Stripe and can significantly slow startup or block it if Stripe is unreachable.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET defaults to empty string — if webhook endpoint is hit without a properly configured secret, construct_event will always raise (correct security posture), but there is no boot-time warning if it is unset.

download_expires_at is stored as ISO string; datetime.fromisoformat parses it fine but code assumes it always has tz — if a manual admin edit strips tz it will crash comparing naive vs aware datetimes.
get_current_admin queries user by id but does not check that JWT 'email' still matches — minor, but rotating email in DB would still keep old tokens fully valid.
seed_data_creation: Test data inserted through normal flows: newsletter TEST_* emails, TEST_ contact message, one real paid Stripe test order for 'Budget mensuel'. All prefixed TEST_ or naturally scoped (Stripe test mode).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_lamaisondauben.py — 22 tests, all pass. Runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Full Stripe flow was executed once (session cs_test_a1xvjZ7Td... resulted in a paid order + xlsx download). Admin flow verified. Everything green.
